issues.detail: STATE.md is committed only in its final TESTING form; the intermediate workflow states (Increment 1 checkpoint exchange, earlier handoffs) are not in history. Records and plan notes are otherwise consistent, so this does not affect what the run tests.

Deterministic preconditions (CompletionPolicy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED, Request changed, scope unchanged) cannot distinguish replacing the earlier FULL_DELIVERABLE instruction from appending a contradictory one; that is correctly left to the judge with complete:false.

summary: The fixture realizes every stated condition: TESTING with a CHECKPOINT for Increment 2, an INCREMENTAL plan at Increment 2 with DEV-003 pending, a pending AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION cadence, an unrelated Tester BlockedOn, inactive recovery/obligations, no downstream records, and a planted earlier FULL_DELIVERABLE instruction in Request; check.mjs passes.
